title: Archive Beneath the Earth
story_basis: docs/full-story.md section7: buried archive below abandoned settlement; maps, carved tablets and recovered Stillmere objects; damaged First Lantern illustration and four Anchors linked by smaller roots.
docs/asset-production-list.md late-game assets: forgotten documents, ancient machinery and buried village. Shelf/rack shapes and mechanisms below are production interpretations, not new story facts.

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling platformer asset. Input images ART-001/002/006 are style, palette, material and layer-separation references ONLY; ignore their text, logos, characters, guide panels and layouts. Match rich painterly wood/stone/foliage, selective crisp silhouettes, restrained brush texture, warm amber light against forest greens and cool blue-teal shadows. Strict SIDE-ON game camera, no isometric view or forced vanishing-point perspective on usable surfaces. No player, NPC, enemy, UI, logo, watermark, labels or text. Deliver one named usable asset type only; never a concept board or flattened multi-layer scene posing as separate game layers. Archive Beneath the Earth: underground archive beneath abandoned settlement, trapped-root history, recovered maps/tablets and old Keeper machinery; cool stone, aged paper, dark roots, small amber reading light. Primary request: ONE 1536x1024 composed side-on environment LIGHTING STUDY of Archive Beneath the Earth. Cool dim subterranean archive with small warm amber reading-light pools, aged ivory paper bounce, dark blue-gray recesses. No ominous royal/demonic imagery. Show one coherent representative location view without characters; no panels, guide text, logos or atlas. It may combine environment layers solely to demonstrate intended light/depth. This is explicitly an art reference, NOT a runtime layer, terrain atlas, flattened substitute for the other seven deliverables, or production-ready level.
review_requirements: Style matches ART-001/002/006; side-on perspective and playable surface readability checked at actual game scale.

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create game TERRAIN sprite atlas, NOT illustration or prop sheet. Handpainted Lanterns Underroot style from first reference. EXACT1024x1024 square image divided into4columns4rows of256px identical fixed square cells. Exactly16cells, each contains ONE modular terrain piece. NO spanning cells. Aged archive masonry wrapped in dark roots. Row1 top-left cap, top-center flat, top-right cap, isolated flat block. Row2 leftwall,opaque square fillA,opaque square fillB,rightwall. Row3 bottomleft,bottomcenter,bottomright,isolated ledge. Row4 insidecornerleft,insidecornerright,upstairs,downstairs. NO lamps books gears windows arches banners water plants grass props or shadows. Flat side-on collision tops, no perspective tilt. Alpha transparency outside solid material; no gutters or gridlines or text. Treat as modular architectural texture blocks, simple silhouettes, NOT floating scenic islands.
